# Query: list_conversations
# SQL: SELECT c.id, c.title FROM conversations c JOIN conversation_participants p ON p.conversation_id = c.id WHERE p.user_id = ? AND p.removed_at_ms IS NULL ORDER BY c.last_activity_at_ms DESC
SCAN p
SEARCH c USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_conversations_1 (id=?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY
